changes.title: Bots home guard
items: The bot game's witch leaves a few fighters on guard at home when she passes by with plenty following her

changes.title: Beach campfires
items: A campfire crackles beside every witch on the beach, to one side of her so she's never hidden

changes.title: Witch bubbles
items: The beach witches and the party witches chat in the same pixel speech bubbles as you and the animals
